purpose: Short trusted-HTTPS Firefox smoke for anonymous meeting-room locking, transfer, offline handover, and empty-room unlock.

flow: owner changes target room from lobby

cases.name: same display name received distinct server participant IDs
wrong room password denied entry; correct password joined
manual transfer selected an online studio member
owner kept studio management after switching to lobby
offline manager handed control to an eligible studio member
former manager reconnected without reclaiming ownership
empty studio stayed locked while its manager remained online in lobby
offline manager with no target-room candidates left the room unlocked
newly joined member relocked the room and became its manager

limits.candidateSelection: The selected successor is checked against the live server member roster; this small sample makes no fairness claim.
limits.maliciousProtocol: Three denial probes use the same joined browser socket; normal UI remains the primary interaction path.
limits.media: No synthetic or physical voice/media path is exercised by this room-control smoke.
limits.persistenceAndCloud: Not evaluated here; root owns server, build, database, and integration evidence.
limits.realUsersAndCapacity: Not tested; four isolated local Firefox contexts are a short functional sample.
